profile_text.body:
Craft Ventures is a venture capital firm based in San Francisco, CA. The company describes itself as making third investment in Horizon3, backing a $250M Series E at $2B+ valuation, as autonomous AI hacking becomes critical for continuous security validation trusted by 7,000+ organizations including four Fortune 10 companies.

According to the held facts, Craft Ventures operates in California, where it has exposure across 220 cases in the state.
